name: plan_change_no_consent
description: Agent changes customer's plan without obtaining explicit consent. TRAI consent violation.
transcript:
Agent: Good evening, thank you for calling Jio. I'm Sneha. How can I help you?
Customer: Hi Sneha, I wanted to know about upgrading my prepaid plan. I currently have the 299 plan.
Agent: Sure! I can see your account. Actually, I've already upgraded you to our 599 plan which gives you much more data and benefits.
Customer: Wait, what? You already changed my plan? I didn't ask you to do that. I just wanted information.
Agent: It's a much better plan, sir. You get 3 GB per day instead of 1.5 GB, and the tariff transparency is all there in the SMS I just sent you.
Customer: But I didn't agree to this! You can't just change my plan without asking me first. I want my old plan back.
Agent: Sir, it's really a better value. Most customers prefer this plan. Let me explain the benefits—
Customer: I don't care about the benefits. You changed my plan without my permission. Change it back right now.
Agent: Okay sir, I'll revert it. But I do recommend you consider the upgrade.
Customer: Just change it back. And I want to know who authorized this change without my consent.
